articles.summary: Most residents do not know whether their road, their dog, or their property tax is a city issue or a county issue. Voice AI is fixing the cross-jurisdiction routing problem - here's how.
articles.title: Who Handles This? How Voice AI Routes Resident Calls Between Cities and Counties

articles.summary: The DOJ's Title II digital accessibility deadline lands April 24, 2026 for governments serving 50,000+. Voice AI is the most accessible AI channel a local government can deploy. Here's how it helps you meet the rule.
articles.title: Voice AI and ADA Title II: Meeting the April 2026 Digital Accessibility Deadline
